ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous zones on the distal halves of the lobes. Left lobe contains a broad white field bounded by a solid black superior margin. Right lobe white field is heavily fragmented by vertical low-intensity striations and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 38 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/6th of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. The left lobe displays higher amplitude, sharper peaks (jagged) near the tip, while the right lobe exhibits lower amplitude, more rounded undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature extending from the notch to the tips, with a slight concave inflection point on the outer third of the left lobe trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters detected near the distal tip of the right lobe and multiple small circular spots dispersed within the central white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and slightly diagonal black linear streaks (consistent with rake marks) visible on the white field of the right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique feathered pigmentation pattern on the right lobe where white and black pixels interleave in a striated, non-contiguous manner compared to the more solid white block on the left lobe.
